description: Metadata for public Montreal AI Ethics Institute pages on montrealethics.ai. Each URL was confirmed with one bounded HTML GET. Omitted hosts: montrealethics.org, www.montrealethics.org, www.montrealethics.ai, brief.montrealethics.ai, open.substack.com, www.youtube.com, www.facebook.com, ssir.org, www.weforum.org. Challenges, captchas, robots disallows, and off-host redirects are not stored. Rows store title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. No body, abstract, quote, transcript, or chart data. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a mix of those. Sole CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-SA, and CC BY-NC-ND keep their tokens. Mixed restricted and permissive text stays unknown. uk_ogl requires Open Government Licence. mit, apache-2.0, and mpl-2.0 stay their own tokens. runner_wired is false.
